environment.description: Same Spring Boot application deployed on AWS Lambda via aws-serverless-java-container. The Lambda Function URL is configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The function's resource-based policy contains no lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission grants to '*' or 'AWS:*'. The only principal authorized is role arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/InternalReportingCallerRole which is assumable only by the internal frontend service running in a private VPC. Note: the XSS pattern check in the code does not filter format specifiers like %s or %5$s, and the Formatter still processes user input as a format string. The application-level vulnerability remains present in the code.

config.network: function URL requires SigV4 signed requests
